item.title: There’s No Place Like Home — A Touching Performance at Bluebarn Theatre
item.description: The Heart Sellers opened at Bluebarn Theatre on Feb. 5 in an emotional performance that left the audience wiping away tears. Jane (played by Evelyn Choi) and Luna (played by Biannah Peji-Palm) are two immigrant women who find each other on a lonely Thanksgiving night.
